title: Structural Complexity of One-Factor Sparse Portfolio Selection: Exact Algorithms, Parameterized Hardness, and Restricted Circuit Lower Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2609.17626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study exact-cardinality, equally weighted minimum-variance portfolio selection under a one-factor covariance model supplied in factor form. In the nonnegative homoskedastic regime, selecting the K smallest loadings is optimal. Allowing strictly positive asset-specific idiosyncratic variances makes the decision problem NP-complete even with positive integer loadings and a strictly positive-definite covariance matrix; with identity residual covariance, exactly one negative loading also suffices. We give exact pseudo-polynomial dynamic programs for one factor and fixed factor dimension and prove W[1]-hardness parameterized by K, including the positive-data family. Consequently, a general exact polynomial-time algorithm for Monge's (2017) equally weighted single-factor variance-input formulation would imply P=NP. For a normalized binary factor encoding, we construct a depth-zero projection from modular k-SUM that preserves exact cardinali

translated_title: 单因子稀疏投资组合选择的结构复杂性：精确算法、参数化困难性与受限电路下界
translated_abstract: 我们研究在以因子形式给出的一因子协方差模型下，精确基数、等权重的最小方差投资组合选择问题。在非负同方差情形下，选取K个最小载荷即为最优。而一旦允许严格为正的资产特质方差，即使载荷为正整数且协方差矩阵严格正定，该判定问题也变为NP完全的；当残差协方差为单位矩阵时，仅存在一个负载荷也足以导致NP完全性。我们针对单因子及固定因子维度的情形给出了精确的伪多项式动态规划算法，并证明了以K为参数的W[1]-困难性，包括正数据族的情形。因此，若能为Monge（2017）的等权重单因子方差输入形式给出一般性的精确多项式时间算法，则意味着P=NP。对于规范化的二进制因子编码，我们从模k-SUM构造了一个深度为零的投影，该投影保持精确基数（原文在此截断）。
tldr: 本文证明了一因子等权重稀疏最小方差投资组合选择问题在允许正特质方差或单个负载荷时即为NP完全，且以K为参数时是W[1]-困难的，同时给出了精确的伪多项式动态规划算法，从而表明除非P=NP，否则不存在一般性的精确多项式时间算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that exact-cardinality, equally weighted minimum-variance portfolio selection under a one-factor model is NP-complete when positive idiosyncratic variances or a single negative loading are allowed, and W[1]-hard when parameterized by K, while providing exact pseudo-polynomial dynamic programs and implying that no general exact polynomial-time algorithm exists unless P=NP.
